purpose: Native ambient Wi-Fi and Cell detail completeness in the existing range and day readers. Source and test authorship only.
production_hunk: Require exact child count for native facts whose existing purposeDemandId marker is non-null, including when every child is missing. Preserve null-marker legacy summaries without children and the existing count check on legacy facts with children.
authored_scenarios: Wi-Fi: start with a valid v6 current fact and two detail children, delete all children through the real DAO, and require StorageUnavailable from range and day readers.
Cell: the same missing-all scenario through real Room joins.
Wi-Fi: delete one of two current detail children and require StorageUnavailable from both readers.
Cell: the same missing-part scenario through real Room joins.
Wi-Fi: a valid v6 detail group exposes the exact names, access-point IDs and observation times through both readers.
Cell: a valid v6 detail group exposes the exact tower IDs, registered state and observation times through both readers.
Wi-Fi: a null-marker legacy summary without children remains readable through both readers.
Cell: a null-marker legacy summary without children remains readable through both readers.
preserved_reader_review: Public reads use the injected IO dispatcher and one Room transaction; cancellation is rethrown and storage/integrity failures return the existing unavailable result.
Existing internal readInTransaction and readDayInTransaction remain available without a second collection or qualification pipeline.
Current native children are loaded in bounded current-cursor chunks and checked against parent owner, revision, checksum and exact count.
Imported correction history, identity checks, child checksums and summary-only compatibility remain unchanged.
boundaries: No new entity, schema, format, marker or abstraction. Uses the already-approved native v6 purposeDemandId marker.

This reader slice checks native detail completeness; it does not add full WAL, provider, policy or sequence authority authentication. Paired retained map qualification is owned by the R13 implementation.
Midnight grouping, historical capture-group authority, imported format detail completeness and whole-source acceptance remain outside this slice.
No compilation, test execution, resource validation, schema gate, device/UI evidence or integration performed.
